finding: Tabari records that some Arabic-language scholars construed wa-nhar as facing the qibla with one's chest. The following explanation cites an Arabic usage in which houses face one another, an Asad poem, and a gloss explaining the image. The wording about hearing the usage is impersonal; no named scholar or complete oral route is supplied.
